spans.s:
mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
1 Lovely, beautiful.
2 Stupid, ignorant, an idiot, a fool.
3 Simple, silly.
f. (-ग्धा)
A young and lovely female.
E.
मुह to be foolish, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.

Ignorance, stupidity.
3 Simplicity.
E.
मुग्ध, and तल् added; also मुग्धत्वं.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Lovely-faced.
E.
मुग्ध, and आनन face.
